content.subject: Modern issuer processing and legacy payments
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. I'm reaching out because modern issuer processing may be an area we could help with.

I read your post about building modern issuer processing, especially your point about legacy payments not fitting today's fintech world. I imagine keeping payment reconciliations aligned across evolving markets can become increasingly time-consuming.

We extract transaction data from multiple rails and reconcile it automatically, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
